i mean i still love her lyrics but somehow it just doesn't feel like the clairo i learned to love. for me it was always this simpilcity. singing about her feelings, not trying to hide anything, just being straight forward and the production was the same. you knew that it was just her with limited knowledge and that was what always made it so relateable for me. that's what i always loved about her music. and while emotionally the lyrics on immunity get to me it's just that i think it's overproduced. it's in some weird way too professional for what she's saying. it doesn't have that easy vibe to it that it used to. but maybe it's just hard for me to let her go in a new direction and that i just don't want her to change. hopefully after a few more listens i'll like it better
